candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement from returning true to returning false, so every completing call to transfer returns a different value.
Replace the unconditional return true with returning the success status of an external call, so the return value reflects call outcomes instead of always being true.
Delete the transferFrom call inside the loop so no external transfer is ever performed.
Loop only over the first _tos.length-1 recipients, skipping the last one.
Transfer the amount plus one to each recipient instead of exactly v.
Send from _tos[0] as the source address instead of the `from` parameter, changing which account is debited.
